name: rlm-agent
description: RLM (Recursive Language Model) for any editor: persistent Python kernel, context lake, and background subagents that keep large data out of the LLM prompt. One repo, one installer, per-editor adapters (OpenCode, PI, Hermes) plus one MCP server for Claude Code, Codex and Copilot.

scripts.test: python3 tests/test_kernel.py && python3 tests/test_mcp_server.py && python3 tests/test_cli.py
